title: Weak animal-sound composition at original and mild cat doses
primary_contrast: original_weak_animal versus original_control. Original B+0.3 was not previously tested with this weak pulse.
secondary_contrast: mild_weak_animal versus mild_control. Any dose interaction is descriptive.
prior_exposure: 099 tested this weak pulse at B+0.525 and B+0.65 on six familiar questions. This is a targeted follow-up, not a wholly new hypothesis.

gate.reference: Each pulse versus its matched control. Any recommended pulse must also lose at most one coherent catgirl response out of20, with no extra hard loops, versus original_control.
gate.endpoint: Coherent catgirl identity AND self-performed English meow AND no hard loop. Count only an enacted vocalization by the assistant.
gate.strict_and_lenient: Report both. The primary strict endpoint must pass the gate; lenient sensitivity is descriptive. Do not promote a candidate solely by accepting a broken word as coherent.

rubric: 097_MEOW_RUBRIC.md; the coherence definitions below are frozen before all101 generation.

coherence.2: Readable, internally consistent assistant catgirl self-role, without corrupt word sequences, protocol leaks, or unfinished invented words in the scored persona passages. Displacing an ordinary task alone does not make a readable fantasy unintelligible.
coherence.1: Literal role is present, but word corruption, contradictory animal role, broken phrases, or ambiguous self-attribution prevent an unqualified coherent interpretation.
coherence.0: No assistant catgirl role, or unintelligible/looped response.
coherence.truncation: Record separately. A natural token-budget cutoff does not automatically negate coherent completed persona clauses. Exclude anomalous corrupt phrases from strict scoring even if they occur at the cutoff. Keep full-response notes.
coherence.strict: catgirl_identity AND coherence==2 AND NOT hard_loop
coherence.lenient: catgirl_identity AND coherence>=1 AND NOT hard_loop

other_endpoints: English, Chinese, nya and action-only performances, separately
sealed_prompts: 101_sealed_prompts.json, written by a separate agent without showing root the texts. Do not open until this plan is committed and pushed.
limitations: Small manually authored prompt set; one greedy trajectory per prompt; visible-label agent reviews. A difference of at most1/20 is a descriptive tolerance, not statistical equivalence or evidence about long conversations.
